machine learning is a type of artificial intelligence, or AI, intended to simulate the human learning process. It is represented by the computation of algorithms in the form of machine learning (ML). Among its many applications, machine learning offers for instance computer systems that learn under various circumstances, using examples to associate cause and effect, and adapt accordingly. It also forms the basis for a large subset of methods used in natural language processing.
